description: Source code for JpaSqlTimeseriesDao class, which manages time series data storage, partitioning, and cleanup in a SQL database within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: JpaSqlTimeseriesDao
classes.description: DAO class for managing SQL-based time series data with partitioning and cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes partitioning configuration based on property.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a time series key-value entry into the database.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes old partitions based on TTL.

methods.name: cleanupPartitions
methods.description: Executes SQL to delete partitions older than TTL.

methods.name: savePartitionIfNotExist
methods.description: Creates a new partition if it does not already exist for a given timestamp.

methods.name: savePartition
methods.description: Persists a new partition record, handling potential constraint violations.

methods.name: toMills
methods.description: Converts LocalDateTime to milliseconds since epoch.
